hero.heading: Urhobo Progress Union America
hero.subheading: The supreme cultural and developmental body of Urhobo people resident across North America.
hero.motto: Okugbe, Egba, Voyan Robaro (Unity, Strength and Progress)

history.heading: Our History & Purpose
history.accreditation: UPUA is a duly incorporated 501(c)(3) non-profit tax-exempt cultural and humanitarian institution operating under the laws of the United States of America.
body: The Urhobo Progress Union America (UPUA) is the umbrella organization representing all Urhobo associations, chapters, families, and people residing across the United States and Canada.

Rooted in the century-old lineage of the worldwide Urhobo Progress Union founded in 1931, UPUA serves as the supreme beacon of Urhobo culture, language, solidarity, and socio-economic advancement in North America.

Over the decades, UPUA has built bridges of fraternity between diaspora communities and our ancestral homeland in Delta State, Nigeria — sponsoring schools, providing emergency humanitarian relief, advocating for indigenous environmental rights, and mentoring the next generation of global leaders.

missionVision.mission: To unite all Urhobo people and associations in North America into one cohesive, forward-looking brotherhood; to preserve and celebrate our rich monarchical heritage and language; and to mobilize human and financial capital for the educational, economic, and civic elevation of Urhoboland and our host communities.
missionVision.vision: A vibrant, self-sustaining global Urhobo diaspora renowned for cultural pride, institutional excellence, academic achievement, and permanent developmental impact across North America and Urhoboland.

nationalAnthem.heading: The Urhobo National Anthem
nationalAnthem.subheading: The sacred anthem echoing the royal lineage and eternal bond of all Urhobo people.
urhoboLyrics: Edefa me rhiakpo, Urhobo me wan rhe,
Urhobo eh, Orere r'Ivie sa-a Anoma-a.
englishTranslation: Urhobo hail! Land of royal monarchies and dignity.
Urhobo hail! Land of royal monarchies and dignity.
Let all Urhobos gather in unbreakable unity,
Urhobo hail! Land of royal monarchies and dignity.
The boundless love I have for Urhobo,
No other nation compares under the sun.
When next I reincarnate into this mortal earth,
It is through Urhobo that I shall surely return!
